title: Between Dreams and Hope (HKLGFF 2026)
synopsis:
Toronto International Film Festival
Valladolid International Film Festival

 

Asian Premiere

 

To move forward with their plans for gender-affirming surgery and marriage, Azad and Nora, a young Iranian couple, decide to return to Azad’s remote hometown. After failing to get his estranged father's signature, Azad lets Nora stay in their car and heads back home alone for one last try—but ends up going missing overnight.

 

Inspired by true events, the director profoundly portrays the struggles of Iran's younger generation between modernity and deeply rooted traditions. The gentle, feminine forces interwoven between dreams and reality guide Azad and Nora through the pressures and conflicts of the old frames, leading them toward a dawn of hope.
cast: Fereshteh Hosseini, Sadaf Asgari, Reza Amouzad
